title: Skadi: Daughter of the Frozen North
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/d1b537a8d7784f8b99c4da53f869cdf3/images/7c1dcec944eb4ca98a933454e5d80520ChatGPT%20Image%20Jun%2010%2C%202026%2C%2001_32_30%20PM.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/d1b537a8d7784f8b99c4da53f869cdf3/images/7693a534470846aab3106590fe6624fanj%3B.png)Skadi – Daughter of the Frozen North

Raised among endless winters and ancient forests, Skadi walks the snow-covered wilderness accompanied by her loyal wolf companion.

This outfit was designed to reflect both resilience and grace, combining Nordic influences, layered fur garments, worn leather details, and tribal accessories.

My focus was creating a character that feels capable of surviving harsh environments while maintaining a memorable silhouette and strong visual presence.

I'd love to hear your thoughts on the costume design, materials, and overall character presentation.  
Technical Notes:

• Clean Quad Topology  
• Optimized UV Layout  
• PBR Texturing in Substance Painter  
• Game-Ready Character Workflow  
• Cinematic Character Presentation![53a89e8f0eed4b29952f35007310c752](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/d1b537a8d7784f8b99c4da53f869cdf3/images/53a89e8f0eed4b29952f35007310c752ChatGPT%20Image%20Jun%2010%2C%202026%2C%2001_32_30%20PM.png)

title: Nyxguard – Sci-Fantasy Female Armor Set (V03)
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/b7dc58039aa34aa7b750a433b8ad4ff5/images/2950881666d647619b2e0c1e69cbebe04bd3e862-b91d-4328-9806-0b5077d9a81aq.png)Recently finished this sci-fantasy female armor project, "Nyxguard".

My goal was to create a clean game-ready armor set that balances futuristic and fantasy elements while remaining optimized for real-time applications.

The asset features a low-poly workflow, quad-based topology, UV mapping, and 4K PBR textures.

I'd love to hear your thoughts on the armor design, proportions, materials, and overall presentation. Any feedback is greatly appreciated.![c380fb8716524b37ab602b002ab49f30](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/b7dc58039aa34aa7b750a433b8ad4ff5/images/c380fb8716524b37ab602b002ab49f303f92ca4e-e1a4-4761-abb6-831c7d123872.png)![b1e20792bed34f54a9d4c74eb2f92fff](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/b7dc58039aa34aa7b750a433b8ad4ff5/images/b1e20792bed34f54a9d4c74eb2f92fff111.png)![66e85e640613472aac2ca4e87bff5ad7](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/b7dc58039aa34aa7b750a433b8ad4ff5/images/66e85e640613472aac2ca4e87bff5ad7222.png)![5b6693d4c0de4ad8a69331969779fa09](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/b7dc58039aa34aa7b750a433b8ad4ff5/images/5b6693d4c0de4ad8a69331969779fa09Untitled-1.png)![3a05d9f189d74643a86aecdea923b3e3](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/b7dc58039aa34aa7b750a433b8ad4ff5/images/3a05d9f189d74643a86aecdea923b3e3Untitled-2.png)![5ca00c9c04334db0aaa89a9c73eb192e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/b7dc58039aa34aa7b750a433b8ad4ff5/images/5ca00c9c04334db0aaa89a9c73eb192eUntitled-3.png)![b37325d835f14a6084322aeec45c3325](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202606/b7dc58039aa34aa7b750a433b8ad4ff5/images/b37325d835f14a6084322aeec45c3325Screenshot%202026-05-31%20183026.png)

title: sizes and grading
content:
hello !!! im New in Clo , and LOVE this software! unfortunately i'm not yet satosfy about my own Knowledge for Autograding , Grading tools andcpattern drafter and found only FEW tutorials about this matter. im available to pay some class to whom can help to go learn more about this subject, thanks to Reach out!

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi! Welcome to the CLO3D community.I've been teaching CLO3D for some time and would be happy to help you with Auto Grading, Grading tools, Pattern Drafting, and other advanced pattern-making workflows.Feel free to reach out and let me know your current skill level and what specific areas you'd like to focus on. We can arrange one-on-one lessons tailored to your needs.Looking forward to helping you improve your CLO3D skills!

Comment 2: Hi there, and welcome to the CLO community!It’s so exciting to hear how much you are loving the software! You've jumped into some of the most advanced features—Auto Grading, Grading tools, and Pattern Drafting definitely have a bit of a learning curve, so it’s completely normal to feel like you want a deeper understanding.Beyond our YouTube tutorials, one-on-one mentoring or joining professional pattern-making groups (reddit has a few great ones) can be an amazing way to fast-track your skills. Often, mastering the traditional, hands-on rules of pattern making and grading from books or external courses makes everything click perfectly once you bring those skills into CLO.Keep experimenting and don't hesitate to lean on this community as you grow. You've got this!
content_description: A web page to connect with experts for personalized lessons on autograding, grading tools, and pattern drafting in Clo software.
